jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Mount Abraham Unified School District, a unified union district that is its own supervisory district (member towns: Bristol, Monkton, New Haven, Starksboro; Lincoln withdrew effective July 1, 2023). Formed July 1, 2018; operates PK-12.
Mount Abraham Unified School District (official site).

sources.note: Mount Abraham USD "Board Position Expirations" sheet (official, linked from the district board page; updated June 3, 2025): position rows Bristol 1-5, Monkton 1-3, New Haven 1-2, Starksboro 1-3, with occupants by school year (the 2025-26 and 2026-27 rows agree name-for-name with the board page bios). Despite its title the sheet records occupancy by year, not expiration years -- NO term expiration is published for any member in any fetched official document (missing: the member towns' March 2026 official returns). The sheet annotates three appointments: Kielee Pelland (Monkton, 12/19/23), Meredith Rossignol (Bristol, 9/24/24), Sarah Louer (New Haven, 7/30/24).

Town of Bristol FY2025 Annual Report (official), Annual Meeting Warning Art. 2: Bristol voters elect by Australian ballot on March 3, 2026 "one Mount Abraham Unified School District School Board member for a three-year term" among the town officers; the Town of Starksboro 2025 warning likewise puts MAUSD directors on Starksboro's ballot, and the district's own warning carries no director article -- town-only electorates (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(1) pattern). The adopted Articles of Agreement verbatim were not obtained (the 2016 ANESU unification report PDF is unextractable).

board.post_note: MODEL: one post per member town (proportional, town-only electorates, 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(1) pattern). One membership is HELD: Herb Olson (Starksboro) -- his seat is annotated "VACANT SEAT" in the sheet's 2024-25 row and he occupies it from 2025-26, but no fetched document states how he was seated (missing: the Starksboro March 2025 return or board minutes recording his seating).
